ValidationRule.description: SS-10088: For VE & CIO ISR, "Transfer of Ownership" is required when status=Completed, Delivered/Presented. Stakeholders: Laura Narat, Benny Fry, Colin Smith, Erik Gaston 7/21 Deactivated as no longer needed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Transfer_of_Ownership__c = False, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Value_Engineering_Request", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Vertical_CIO_Strategist_Request" ), OR( ISPICKVAL( Status__c, "Completed"), ISPICKVAL( Status__c, "Delivered/Presented") ), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For VE & CIO ISR, "Transfer of Ownership" is required when status=Completed, Delivered/Presented.
